name: Meeting Transcript → Google Docs + Google Tasks + Gmail + Calendar

body.prompt: You are a meeting assistant. Summarize this meeting transcript into clear meeting minutes and extract all action items. Include attendees' names from the transcript. Respond ONLY in JSON with keys: minutes (string), tasks (array of {title, due_date, assignee_email}). Transcript: {{$json.transcript}}

parameters.functionCode:
const output = JSON.parse($json.generations[0].text || '{}');
return [{ json: { minutes: output.minutes || '', tasks: output.tasks || [], attendees: $json.attendees, meetingTitle: $json.meetingTitle, meetingDate: $json.meetingDate } }];

parameters.subject: ={{`Meeting Summary - ${$json.meetingTitle}`}}
